description: This PHP source file defines the CustomFieldController class for managing custom fields in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller, provides constants for different screens and field types, and prepares data for rendering a Vue component related to custom fields.

classes.name: CustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller class for managing custom fields in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, utilizing Vue components for UI rendering.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties like list of custom fields, screens, and field types for rendering the custom field interface.
